corner_won.name: Corner Won
corner_won.definition: An attacking sequence that results in the ball crossing the goal line, without a goal being scored, after being last touched by the defending team, thereby awarding a corner kick to the attacking team.

role_definitions.corner_winner: The attacking player whose action directly leads to the corner being awarded.
role_definitions.corner_conceder: The defending player whose touch or defensive action directly results in the corner being awarded.

corner_won.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **corner winner first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target corner**, allowing subsequent dribbling, crossing, passing, or shooting. It ends when, after the **defending team makes the final touch, block, or clearance**, the ball crosses the goal line and the corner outcome becomes clear.

corner_kick.name: Corner Kick
corner_kick.definition: The restart of play in which the attacking team puts the ball back into play from the corner area after a corner has been awarded.

role_definitions.corner_taker: The attacking player who takes the target corner kick.

corner_kick.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view and the **corner taker begins taking the corner kick**. It ends after the corner is taken when the **ball is first touched by a player other than the corner taker or goes out of play**.

shot_on_target.name: Shot on Target
shot_on_target.definition: An attacking sequence culminating in an intentional attempt to score that is directed toward the goal and either results in a goal or is prevented from entering the goal.

role_definitions.last_passer: The attacking player who makes the final effective pass to the shooter before the shot.
role_definitions.shooter: The attacking player who takes the shot.
role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper defending the goal against the shot.

shot_on_target.temporal_boundary_with_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **last passer first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target shot**, allowing subsequent dribbling. The window ends when the **outcome of the shot becomes clear**.
shot_on_target.temporal_boundary_without_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **shooter first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target shot or begins direct preparation for the shot**, allowing subsequent dribbling when applicable. The window ends when the **outcome of the shot becomes clear**.

shot_off_target.name: Shot off Target
shot_off_target.definition: An attacking sequence culminating in an intentional attempt to score where the resulting shot is off target.

role_definitions.last_passer: The attacking player who makes the final effective pass to the shooter before the shot.
role_definitions.shooter: The attacking player who takes the shot.
role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper defending the goal targeted by the attacking sequence.

shot_off_target.temporal_boundary_with_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **last passer first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target shot**, allowing subsequent dribbling. The window ends when the **outcome of the shot becomes clear**.
shot_off_target.temporal_boundary_without_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **shooter first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target shot or begins direct preparation for the shot**, allowing subsequent dribbling when applicable. The window ends when the **outcome of the shot becomes clear**.

goal.name: Goal
goal.definition: An attacking sequence culminating in a valid goal, where the ball completely crosses the goal line between the goalposts and under the crossbar.

role_definitions.last_passer: The attacking player who makes the final effective pass to the shooter before the target goal.
role_definitions.shooter: The attacking player whose shot results in the target goal.
role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper defending the goal in which the target goal is scored.

goal.temporal_boundary_with_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **last passer first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target goal**, allowing subsequent dribbling. The window ends when the **goal outcome becomes clear**.
goal.temporal_boundary_without_last_passer: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **shooter first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target goal or begins direct preparation for the shot**, allowing subsequent dribbling when applicable. The window ends when the **goal outcome becomes clear**.

throw_in.name: Throw-in
throw_in.definition: A restart of play in which the ball is thrown back into the field after having crossed the touchline and a throw-in has been awarded.

role_definitions.throw_in_taker: The player who takes the target throw-in.

throw_in.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view with the **throw-in player and the ball visible**. It ends after the ball is thrown back into play when the **ball is first touched or controlled by a player other than the throw-in player**.

goal_kick.name: Goal Kick
goal_kick.definition: A restart of play awarded to the defending team after the ball crosses the goal line without a goal being scored, having last been touched by the attacking team.

role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper who takes the target goal kick.

goal_kick.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view and the **goalkeeper begins taking the goal kick**. It ends when the **ball is first touched or controlled by a player other than the goalkeeper**.

kick_off.name: Kick-off
kick_off.definition: A restart from the center of the field used to begin a half or to resume play after a goal.

role_definitions.kick_off_taker: The player who takes the target kick-off.

kick_off.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **kick-off taker and the ball are visible in the standard broadcast view and the kick-off taker enters the actual kick-off process**. It ends when the **ball is first touched or controlled by a player other than the kick-off taker**.

offside.name: Offside
offside.definition: An attacking sequence that results in play being stopped because an attacking player is judged to have committed an offside offence, typically indicated by the assistant referee raising the flag.

role_definitions.offside_passer: The attacking player who makes the pass associated with the target offside event.
role_definitions.offside_player: The attacking player who is judged to have committed the target offside offence.
role_definitions.second_last_defender: The second-last defending player relative to the defending goal line when the offside pass is made, serving as the reference defender for the target offside event.

offside.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **offside passer first gains possession of the ball during the attacking sequence of the target offside event**, allowing subsequent dribbling before passing the ball to the offside player. It ends when the **offside decision becomes clear and the referee stops the current attacking phase**.

indirect_free_kick.name: Indirect Free-kick
indirect_free_kick.definition: The restart of play following an offside decision, in which the defending team puts the ball back into play with an indirect free-kick. Can look similar to a goal kick

role_definitions.indirect_free_kick_taker: The player who takes the target indirect free-kick following the offside decision.

indirect_free_kick.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view and the **indirect free-kick taker begins taking the indirect free-kick**. It ends when the **ball is first touched or controlled by a player other than the indirect free-kick taker**.

foul_direct_free_kick.name: Foul Leading to Direct Free-kick
foul_direct_free_kick.definition: A foul committed during open play that results in the opposing team being awarded a direct free-kick.

role_definitions.foul_committer: The player who commits the target foul.
role_definitions.fouled_player: The opposing player who is fouled in the target event.

foul_direct_free_kick.temporal_boundary: If the fouled player is in possession of the ball, the **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **fouled player first gains possession during the target foul sequence**, allowing subsequent dribbling. If the foul occurs off the ball, the window starts when the **fouled player begins a direct contest, positional duel, or physical contact with the fouler**. It ends when the **foul action occurs and the foul decision becomes clear**.

direct_free_kick.name: Direct Free-kick
direct_free_kick.definition: The restart of play in which a direct free-kick is taken following the corresponding foul decision, with an attempt to score directly, including situations in which the defending team forms a defensive wall.

role_definitions.direct_free_kick_taker: The player who takes the target direct free-kick.
role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper defending the goal against the target direct free-kick.

direct_free_kick.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view and the **direct free-kick taker begins taking the direct free-kick**. It ends when the **outcome of the direct free-kick becomes clear**, including when a goal is scored or when the ball goes out of play or first touched by a player other than the direct free-kick taker.

foul_penalty.name: Foul Leading to Penalty
foul_penalty.definition: A foul committed by the defending team that results in the attacking team being awarded a penalty kick.

role_definitions.foul_committer: The defending player who commits the target foul.
role_definitions.fouled_player: The attacking player who is fouled in the target event.

foul_penalty.temporal_boundary: If the fouled player is in possession of the ball, the **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **fouled player first gains possession during the target foul sequence**, allowing subsequent dribbling. If the foul occurs off the ball, the window starts when the **fouled player begins a direct contest, positional duel, or physical contact with the fouler**. It ends when the **foul action occurs and the foul decision becomes clear**.

penalty_kick.name: Penalty Kick
penalty_kick.definition: The penalty-kick procedure following a penalty decision, culminating in the kick from the penalty mark.

role_definitions.penalty_taker: The player who takes the target penalty kick.
role_definitions.goalkeeper: The goalkeeper defending the goal against the target penalty kick.

penalty_kick.temporal_boundary: The **temporal window to be localized** starts when the video is in a standard broadcast view and the **penalty taker begins taking the penalty kick**. It ends when the **outcome of the penalty kick becomes clear**, including when a goal is scored or when the ball is first touched or controlled by a player other than the penalty taker.

foul_yellow_card.name: Foul Leading to Yellow Card
foul_yellow_card.definition: A foul that results in the offending player receiving a yellow card.

role_definitions.foul_committer: The player who commits the target foul and receives the resulting yellow card.
role_definitions.fouled_player: The opposing player who is fouled in the target event.

foul_yellow_card.temporal_boundary: If the fouled player is in possession of the ball, the **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **fouled player first gains possession during the target foul sequence**, allowing subsequent dribbling. If the foul occurs off the ball, the window starts when the **fouled player begins a direct contest, positional duel, or physical contact with the fouler**. It ends when the **foul action occurs and the foul decision becomes clear**.

foul_red_card.name: Foul Leading to Red Card
foul_red_card.definition: A foul that results in the offending player receiving a direct red card.

role_definitions.foul_committer: The player who commits the target foul and receives the resulting direct red card.
role_definitions.fouled_player: The opposing player who is fouled in the target event.

foul_red_card.temporal_boundary: If the fouled player is in possession of the ball, the **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **fouled player first gains possession during the target foul sequence**, allowing subsequent dribbling. If the foul occurs off the ball, the window starts when the **fouled player begins a direct contest, positional duel, or physical contact with the fouler**. It ends when the **foul action occurs and the foul decision becomes clear**.

foul_second_yellow_red_card.name: Foul Leading to Second Yellow and Red Card
foul_second_yellow_red_card.definition: A foul that results in the offending player receiving a second yellow card and the consequent red card.

role_definitions.foul_committer: The player who commits the target foul and receives the second yellow card and consequent red card.
role_definitions.fouled_player: The opposing player who is fouled in the target event.

foul_second_yellow_red_card.temporal_boundary: If the fouled player is in possession of the ball, the **temporal window to be localized** starts when the **fouled player first gains possession during the target foul sequence**, allowing subsequent dribbling. If the foul occurs off the ball, the window starts when the **fouled player begins a direct contest, positional duel, or physical contact with the fouler**. It ends when the **foul action occurs and the foul decision becomes clear**.

rules.oracle:
- Track the same player for each role throughout the event. If not reliably visible, output `null`; resume the same player when visible again.
- At each of the following timestamps, measured from the beginning of the input video, output a tight bounding box for each role-bearing person as `[xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]`, normalized to `[0,1000]`, with the origin at the top-left:
  {oracle_timestamps}
  Use each listed timestamp exactly once and do not add other timestamps.
rules.context:
- Track the same player for each role throughout the event. If not reliably visible, output `null`; resume the same player when visible again.
- The window must remain within a continuous standard broadcast view and must not cross a cut or non-standard view.
- Starting at `temporal_window.start_sec`, output role localization every 0.5 seconds (`temporal_window.start_sec`, `temporal_window.start_sec + 0.5`, ...), without exceeding `temporal_window.end_sec`.
- At each timestamp, output a tight bounding box for each role-bearing person as `[xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]`, normalized to `[0,1000]`, with the origin at the top-left.

release_conventions.answer_time_reference: beginning of the input video, not the on-screen match clock
release_conventions.sampling: nominal 2 Hz: Oracle time_sec = k * 0.5; context time_sec = target_start_in_window + k * 0.5; retain the explicitly annotated support only
release_conventions.original_spatial_frame_index: zero-based in the original Oracle event clip; round_half_up(fps_original * 0.5 * k)
release_conventions.original_spatial_time_sec: actual original event-clip frame_index / fps_original; may differ from nominal half-second timestamps
release_conventions.original_spatial_bbox_format: xyxy in original_video_pixels; dimensions and frame IDs retained in spatial_annotation
release_conventions.null: an explicit null for a requested role at a timestamp has the existing benchmark meaning of no reliable localization; it is distinct from missing or invalid prediction fields
release_conventions.sample_identity: sample_id is unchanged and shared across all five settings
release_conventions.model_input: video plus complete official prompt; answer, spatial_annotation and GT/source timing metadata must not be sent as model input
